title: Return policy
text: Most Nimbu Living products can be returned within 7 days from delivery. The product must be unused and sent back with its original packaging and accessories. Start the request from My Orders so our team can arrange pickup.

title: Returns during the Diwali sale
text: Orders placed during the Diwali sale from 20 October to 5 November get a 15-day return window. The window starts on the delivery date. Yes, this is longer than the normal return period. Normal condition and packaging checks still apply.

title: Returns for final-sale items
text: Final-sale items are not returnable. If a final-sale item arrives damaged or defective, you can request an exchange within 48 hours. Yes, an item that arrived broken is eligible for this exchange. Share clear unboxing photos or a video with the request.

title: Return pickup charges
text: A ₹99 pickup fee is deducted from the refund for a standard return. We waive this fee when the item is damaged or when we sent the wrong item. No, a wrong-item return does not pay the fee. The deduction is shown before you confirm the request.

title: Refunds for prepaid orders
text: A prepaid-order refund goes back to the original payment method. It is processed in 5–7 business days after the return is approved. Your bank may take additional time to display the credit.

title: Refunds for COD orders
text: For a cash on delivery order, choose instant Nimbu store credit or a bank transfer by NEFT. NEFT takes 7–10 business days after you share your bank details. We do not send cash or cheques.

title: Shipping charges
text: Shipping is free on orders above ₹999. Orders of ₹999 or less have a ₹79 shipping charge. The charge is shown in the order summary before payment.

title: Delivery times across India
text: Delivery takes 2–4 business days in metro cities and 4–7 business days in the rest of India. Yes, delivery is normally quicker in a metro than a non-metro city. North-East states and Jammu and Kashmir take 7–10 business days. These estimates begin after dispatch.

title: Cash on delivery
text: Cash on delivery is available for orders up to ₹10,000. No, COD is not available above that limit. A ₹49 COD fee applies. Orders above the limit must use a prepaid payment method.

title: Cancelling an order
text: Cancellation is free before dispatch. After dispatch, you can refuse delivery. A prepaid order refused after dispatch is refunded minus the ₹79 shipping charge.

title: Changing a delivery address
text: You can change the delivery address until the order is packed. Packing usually happens within 12 hours of ordering. Yes, a recent order can be updated if packing has not started. Once packed, cancel before dispatch and place a new order instead.

title: Product warranty periods
text: Nimbu cookware has a 2-year warranty. Appliances have a 1-year brand warranty. Textiles such as bedsheets and towels have no warranty.

title: Item damaged on arrival
text: Report an item damaged on arrival within 48 hours. Include clear unboxing photos or a video. Once approved, the replacement ships in 3–5 business days.

title: Size and colour exchanges
text: A size or colour exchange can be requested within 7 days. Yes, this matches the normal 7-day return window. One exchange is allowed per order and it is free. No, a second exchange is not allowed for the same order. The item must be unused with tags and packaging intact.

title: Nimbu Points
text: You earn 1 Nimbu Point for every ₹100 spent. One point is worth ₹1 and points expire after 12 months. Yes, that is the same validity period as a gift card. Points can pay for up to 20% of an order.

title: Nimbu gift cards
text: Nimbu gift cards are valid for 12 months. They are non-refundable and cannot be bought with Nimbu Points. A gift card can be used across multiple orders until its balance is finished.

title: No-cost EMI
text: No-cost EMI is available on orders above ₹3,000 with select credit cards. The available tenures are 3 or 6 months. Choose the plan at checkout. Eligibility depends on the issuing bank.

title: International shipping
text: Nimbu Living does not offer international shipping. We deliver within India only. An Indian delivery address is required at checkout.

title: Getting a GST invoice
text: Download your GST invoice from My Orders after shipment. A business GSTIN must be added before placing the order. A GSTIN cannot be added to an invoice after checkout.

title: Tracking your order
text: We send a tracking link by SMS and email after dispatch. The same link appears in My Orders. Tracking may take a few hours to update after the courier collects the parcel.

title: How to request a return
text: Open My Orders and select Request return within 7 days from delivery. Choose a reason and pickup slot, then keep the original packaging ready. A standard return has a ₹99 pickup fee unless the item is damaged or wrong.

title: Exchanging a defective final-sale product
text: A final-sale product cannot be returned for a change of mind. A damaged or defective final-sale product can be exchanged within 48 hours. Add unboxing photos or a video so the team can review it.

title: Diwali sale return eligibility
text: The extended return period applies only to orders placed from 20 October through 5 November. Eligible orders have 15 days from delivery to request a return. Orders outside those dates use the normal 7-day window.

title: Redeeming Nimbu Points
text: At checkout, Nimbu Points can cover up to 20% of the order value. Each point is worth ₹1 and expires after 12 months. Points cannot be used to buy gift cards.

title: Checking a refund status
text: Prepaid refunds return to the original payment method in 5–7 business days after approval. COD customers choosing NEFT receive the transfer in 7–10 business days after sharing bank details. Store credit for a COD refund is instant.

title: Shipping to the North-East and J&K
text: Orders to North-East states and Jammu and Kashmir usually arrive in 7–10 business days after dispatch. Yes, this is the same range as the COD NEFT refund time. Other non-metro locations take 4–7 business days. We ship only within India.

title: Refusing an order after dispatch
text: An order cannot be cancelled in transit, but you can refuse it at delivery. Prepaid orders are refunded after the parcel returns to us, minus ₹79 shipping. Cancellation remains free before dispatch.

title: Making a warranty claim
text: Keep the invoice when claiming the 2-year cookware warranty or 1-year appliance brand warranty. Textiles have no warranty. Contact support with the order number and photos of the issue.

title: How exchanges work
text: Request one free size or colour exchange from My Orders within 7 days. Keep the item unused with tags attached. A replacement for an item damaged on arrival ships in 3–5 business days after approval.

title: Payment options and limits
text: Pay by card, UPI, eligible EMI, or cash on delivery. COD is limited to orders up to ₹10,000 and costs ₹49. No-cost EMI is offered above ₹3,000 on select credit cards for 3 or 6 months.

title: Business invoices
text: Add your business GSTIN before placing an order. After shipment, download the GST invoice in My Orders. Support cannot add or change a GSTIN after checkout.

title: Gift cards and loyalty points
text: Gift cards remain valid for 12 months and are non-refundable. Nimbu Points cannot be used to purchase a gift card. Points also expire after 12 months and can cover up to 20% of a normal order.

title: Return policy (2024)
text: This policy applied to orders delivered in 2024. Customers could return most products within 30 days of delivery. This article is archived and must not be used for current orders.

title: Shipping charges (2024)
text: During 2024, shipping was free above ₹499. Smaller orders paid ₹49 for shipping. This schedule is archived and no longer applies.

title: Cash on delivery (2024)
text: Cash on delivery used to be available up to ₹5,000. The old COD fee was ₹30. This article is retained for historical reference only.

title: International orders (2023)
text: In a limited 2023 trial, Nimbu Living shipped selected products to the UAE. International delivery was quoted separately. The trial ended and this article is archived.

title: Nimbu Points (2024)
text: Under the old programme, Nimbu Points never expired. Redemption limits differed by campaign. This article is archived and does not describe the current programme.

title: Refunds for COD orders (2024)
text: COD refunds were previously issued only by cheque. Delivery could take several weeks. This process has been retired and the article is archived.

title: Warranty (2023)
text: The 2023 policy gave all products a 1-year warranty. Claims required the original invoice. This policy is archived and no longer applies.

title: Exchange policy (2024)
text: The old exchange policy allowed exchanges within 15 days. Multiple exchanges could be requested in some cases. This article is archived and must not guide current orders.
